assetBaseUrl.description: Absolute base url of decoration assets, e.g. "https://screeps.example.com". Only needed when the client is served from a different origin than the backend; by default assets are referenced relative to the document, which is what lets a proxy serve the client under a path prefix.

builtin.description: Whether to load the decoration pack bundled with the server.

grantAll.description: Whether every user owns the whole decoration catalog. With this off, decorations must be handed out explicitly with `xxscreeps manage decoration grant`.

packs.description: Additional decoration packs to load. Each entry is a path to a `pack.json`, or to the directory holding one.
